calculator.title: Ikhalkhuleyitha
calculator.signBody: Imali oyihlawulayo inegethivu; imali oyifumanayo yipozithivu. Boleka i-R100 000 (PV = +100 000) kwaye intlawulo yakho ivela inegethivu.
calculator.ppyBody: Iintlawulo ngonyaka kunye ne-BGN/END: cinezela i-2ND emva koko i-N ukutshintsha iintlawulo ngonyaka (12, 1, 2, 4); i-2ND emva koko i-PV itshintsha phakathi kwe-END (iintlawulo ekupheleni kwexesha ngalinye) ne-BGN (ekuqaleni). I-CPT emva koko cinezela inani ofuna ukulibala; i-2ND emva koko i-CPT icima amanani amahlanu.
calculator.flowBody: Ukuhamba kwemali: cinezela i-CF, charha inani ngalinye uze ucinezele = ukulifaka (lokuqala lanamhlanje). Emva koko cinezela i-NPV (isebenzisa i-I/Y njengesantya ngexesha ngalinye) okanye i-IRR. I-2ND emva koko i-CF icima uluhlu.
calculator.cfHint: Charha inani, uze ucinezele = ukulifaka. Cinezela i-CF ukuvala.
